question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beats.line: Resulticks is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
beats.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
beats.action: A halftone paper document lands flat on open ground and a rubber stamp presses down onto it, holding.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Resulticks is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI customer data.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the stamped document folds up into a stack of paper coins; a cutout screen rises beside it and locks in place.
beats.delivery: [excited] The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI customer data.

beats.line: It turns a point solution into an integrated platform.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the coin stack flattens into stacked paper sheets; paper clips slide on and bind the sheets into one block.
beats.delivery: It turns a point solution into an integrated platform.

beats.line: Diginex can now serve enterprises across two distinct workflows.
beats.headline: 2 WORKFLOWS
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the bound block splits into two grid paper panels; a stencilled arrow enters and runs from one panel to the other, then stops.
beats.delivery: Diginex can now serve enterprises across two distinct workflows.

beats.line: Compliance buyers can also buy marketing tools from one vendor.
beats.headline: WALLET SHARE
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top as the two panels fold together into a paper shopping cart; torn strips drop into it one by one and settle.
beats.delivery: Compliance buyers can also buy marketing tools from one vendor.

beats.line: The risk is integration complexity across four absorbed acquisitions.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the cart unfolds into four hole-punched tags; string and pins thread between them and pull tight.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] The risk is integration complexity across four absorbed acquisitions.

beats.line: General costs rose three point four million to eight point one million.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the right as the tangled string straightens into a paper bar chart; one bar grows upward and a torn strip caps it.
beats.delivery: General costs rose three point four million to eight point one million.

beats.line: Two point two million of that came from deal legal work.
beats.headline: $2.2M LEGAL
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the tall bar topples into stacked paper files; a paper clip slides over the pile and holds it shut.
beats.delivery: Two point two million of that came from deal legal work.

beats.line: What matters next is cross-sell traction and faster revenue growth.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL PROOF
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the clipped files fan into a paper calendar page; a stencilled arrow climbs across it and holds at the edge.
beats.delivery: What matters next is cross-sell traction and faster revenue growth.

beats.line: Without that, it becomes financial engineering, not a strategic unlock.
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the bottom as the climbing arrow slackens into a torn paper ribbon that drifts down and lies flat.
beats.delivery: Without that, it becomes financial engineering, not a strategic unlock.
